# Legacy Dental Partners

> Comprehensive dental care provider in Albuquerque, NM offering general, restorative, cosmetic, and emergency dentistry services with multiple experienced dentists and flexible financing options.

Legacy Dental Partners is a full-service dental practice in Albuquerque serving patients of all ages. The practice features three experienced dentists (Dr. Stewart Anderson, Dr. Derek Lines, and Dr. Quinn Boyack) and accepts major insurance plans including Delta Dental, Aetna, BlueCross BlueShield, Cigna, and Ameritas.

## Core Services

- [Dental Services](https://www.legacydentalabq.com/services): Comprehensive overview of dental services including implants, cosmetic, and restorative care
- [Family Dentistry](https://www.legacydentalabq.com/services/family-dentistry): Family dentistry services for all ages from kids to adults
- [Dental Implants](https://www.legacydentalabq.com/services/restorative-dentistry/dental-implants): Dental implants for permanent tooth replacement and smile restoration
- [Routine Dental Checkups](https://www.legacydentalabq.com/services/family-dentistry/dental-checkups): Routine dental checkups and preventive care for maintaining oral health
- [Same-Day Crowns & Bridges](https://www.legacydentalabq.com/services/crowns-bridges): Same-day crowns and bridges restoration services with advanced technology
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.legacydentalabq.com/services/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry options for anxiety-free dental care experiences
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://www.legacydentalabq.com/services/emergency-dentistry): Emergency dental care services for urgent dental problems in Albuquerque
